quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #21
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What does a slow-moving vehicle emblem look like?

options.text: A rectangular red sign.
A circular green sign.
A diamond-shaped yellow sign.
A triangular orange sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A triangular orange sign.
questions.explanation: The slow-moving vehicle emblem is a reflective orange triangle. Vehicles with this emblem drive at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: To pass a slower vehicle on a two-lane, two-way road, what must you do?

options.text: Do not cross the centerline.
Flash your lights at oncoming traffic.
Use the shoulder.
Move into the oncoming traffic lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move into the oncoming traffic lane.
questions.explanation: To pass on a two-lane, two-way road, you must move into the oncoming traffic lane. Only pass when it is safe and legal to do so.

questions.question: What do regulatory signs do?

options.text: Are placed in every location where danger is present.
Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
Are diamond-shaped and yellow or green.
Warn drivers about approaching school zones.

questions.correctAnswerText: Tell drivers what they must or must not do.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually rectangular with black markings on white. They tell drivers what they must or must not do. They show speed limits, no passing rules, turn restrictions, and other driving rules.

questions.question: You are waiting to turn left in an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Signal and turn your wheels to the left.
Signal and keep your wheels straight.
Flash your headlights so drivers will let you through.
Drive around the rear of a car blocking you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal and keep your wheels straight.
questions.explanation: Always signal before turning. Keep your wheels straight while waiting to turn left. If another vehicle hits you from behind, you will not be pushed into oncoming traffic.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the road angles toward the center. What does this mean?

options.text: An intersection is just ahead.
You are approaching a construction area.
You must turn left just ahead.
The road is getting narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is getting narrower.
questions.explanation: The white line on the road edge marks the boundary between the travel lane and shoulder. When the line angles toward the center, the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT affect blood alcohol content (BAC)?

options.text: Your body weight.
How much you drink.
How much time passes between drinks.
How physically fit you are.

questions.correctAnswerText: How physically fit you are.
questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Physical fitness or how well you think you handle alcohol does not affect BAC.

questions.question: When entering a highway from an entrance ramp, what should you do?

options.text: Enter faster than traffic to get ahead.
Enter slowly to avoid other vehicles.
Stop first, then slowly enter traffic.
Speed up to match traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Entrance ramps have acceleration lanes. When merging, signal, look for an opening, speed up to match traffic speed, and merge into the opening.

questions.question: You see a flashing yellow light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Drive carefully through the intersection.
Prepare to stop; the light is about to turn red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully through the intersection.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means proceed slowly and with caution. Look both ways for traffic before entering.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: A designated no passing zone.
A one-way traffic area.
The blind spot of a large vehicle.
An area designated for motor vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot of a large vehicle.
questions.explanation: "No zones" are large blind spots around trucks and big vehicles. Avoid staying in these areas.

questions.question: If a driver gets ____ points in a 24-month period, their license will be suspended.
questions.explanation: In Colorado, if a driver gets 18 or more points in a 24-month period, their license will be suspended.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for trucks.
Do not pass trucks.
Truck parking area ahead.
Steep downgrade ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What can a leaking exhaust system do?

options.text: Cause excessive oil use.
Require your vehicle to need a tune-up sooner.
Make you drowsy while driving.
Set grass fires on country roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make you drowsy while driving.
questions.explanation: A leaky exhaust system can release toxic fumes that cause drowsiness while driving. This is very dangerous.

questions.question: If a driver gets ____ points in a 12-month period, their license will be suspended.
questions.explanation: In Colorado, your license will be suspended if you get 12 or more points within a 12-month period.

questions.question: When merging onto a freeway, what should you do?

options.text: Go slowly while waiting for an opening.
Speed up faster than the traffic around you.
Turn on your hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Use the on-ramp to speed up and match the freeway traffic speed. This helps you merge safely and smoothly into traffic.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: You can pass from either direction.
You can pass from the lane with the broken line.
You can pass from the lane with the solid line.
You cannot pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass from the lane with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means you can only pass from the lane next to the broken line.

questions.question: What should you do if there are two railroad tracks side by side?

options.text: It is always safe to cross after one train passes.
You must always stop before crossing the tracks.
Look for another train on the other track after one train passes.
Honk your horn as you cross the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look for another train on the other track after one train passes.
questions.explanation: With two railroad tracks side by side, watch for a second train after one passes. Do not cross until you are sure no train is coming from either direction.

questions.question: What does a speed restriction sign show?

options.text: It can be ignored when it rains, snows, or is icy.
It has a triangular shape.
It is blue with black letters.
It shows a suggested speed for a curve or turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: It shows a suggested speed for a curve or turn.
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs near curves and turns show a suggested speed for those areas. Follow this speed even in good weather. Always slow down more in rain, snow, or ice.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Bicycles are crossing here.
Stop.
Fines are doubled in work zones.
Stop ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bicycles are crossing here.
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road here.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
No left turn.
Merge.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Merge.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon become one. Be ready to merge.

questions.question: Where should you place your hands on the steering wheel?

options.text: 3 and 9 o'clock
1 and 11 o'clock
2 and 10 o'clock
4 and 8 o'clock

questions.correctAnswerText: 3 and 9 o'clock
questions.explanation: Place both hands on the outside of the steering wheel at 3 and 9 o'clock for the best control. The 2 and 10 o'clock position is no longer recommended because airbags can be dangerous there.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines. What may you do?

options.text: Cross these lines only to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.
Cross these lines to pass other vehicles if no traffic is coming.
Never cross these lines.
Cross these lines only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cross these lines only to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Two solid yellow lines mean no passing in either direction. You can only cross them to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: A fully loaded tractor-trailer going 55 mph could take up to ____ to stop completely.

options.text: 50 feet
125 feet
400 feet
750 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 400 feet
questions.explanation: Tractor-trailers need more distance to stop than smaller cars. A fully loaded tractor-trailer may need about 400 feet to stop at 55 mph.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after coming to a complete stop.
You cannot turn right.
You can turn left.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn right.
questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic law sign. It means right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: When parking uphill next to a curb, set the parking brake and:

options.text: Keep the rear tires against the curb.
Keep the front tires straight ahead.
Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
Turn your steering wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, set the parking brake and turn the steering wheel away from the curb. If your car rolls, the curb will stop it.

questions.question: What does a solid red arrow in a traffic signal mean?

options.text: It is never used in traffic signals.
It means the same as a red circular traffic light.
You can turn in the direction the arrow points.
Traffic in that direction must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same as a red circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red circular traffic light. You must stop and cannot turn in that direction.
